title: Dynamic liability band recommendations and legal queue integration
creator: Sofia Ramirez
description: Build an end-to-end capability that recommends a liability/indemnity band and a suggested commercial offset to Sales when an MSA/DPA exception is requested. The feature will surface a recommended band in the Sales contract intake UI, queue exceptions for Legal review with contextual signal, and enable a pricing experiment that measures revenue and time-to-close impact when lower-risk exceptions are auto-approved versus routed to Legal. This ticket covers Product definition, data telemetry requirements, UI wireframes, minimal rule-based recommendation engine (phase 1), Legal queue integration API, and A/B experiment wiring for pricing offset recommendations.
acceptance_criteria: Sales intake UI shows a recommended liability band (Low/Medium/High) and suggested per-month price uplift in 95% of test cases with clear rationale text
Recommendation is computed by the phase-1 rule engine using customer tier, industry, estimated monthly tokens, requested indemnity change, and security questionnaire score
Exceptions created from Sales intake are sent to Legal queue with attached evidence bundle and recommendation metadata
Experiment buckets (Auto-approve, Manual-review, Recommended-only) are configurable and record outcomes to telemetry for conversion, deal size, and SLA metrics
Audit log contains full decision trail for each recommendation and Legal action (who, when, decision, redlines)
Legal team receives a filterable view of queued exceptions and can bulk-apply decision templates or escalate to Contract Negotiation playbook
Documentation and runbook published to Confluence and shared with Sales and Legal; security review completed prior to broad rollout
notes: Phase 1 = rule-based recommendations (deterministic, explainable). Phase 2 will evaluate a lightweight ML ranker after collecting sufficient labeled decisions.
We will not change MSA/DPA wording automatically; the system only recommends bands and pricing offsets. Any change to contract text must be approved and applied by Legal.
Pricing offset model: start with flat percentage uplift tiers tied to liability band. Later iterate to expected revenue delta model per customer segment.
Telemetry schema drafted; requires ENG-41211 to expose intake signals and PM-73111 for pricing experiment infra.
Security: package of SQ answers to be redacted per policy before sending to downstream systems. See security checklist link in links.
